footer_description: Jordan's premier tech-enabled property management company. A division of Thabat, backed by the Kingdom's largest financial institutions.
about_hero_body: Hayyak is the premier, tech-enabled property management division of Thabat, established to redefine the real estate experience across the Levant.
about_jv_thabat_body: A private shareholder company owned by some of the largest banks in Jordan. Provides institutional governance, financial security, and long-term stability for large-scale portfolios.
about_jv_brightlevant_body: A specialized real estate asset manager with a distinguished track record across the Gulf and Jordan. Deep market intelligence and sophisticated asset life-cycle management.
about_pillars_1_body: We treat every property as a strategic investment, utilizing rigorous rent collection and financial modelling to maximize Net Operating Income.
about_pillars_2_body: Our tech-enabled approach implements systematic preventive maintenance and digital reporting for asset longevity.
about_pillars_3_body: Leveraging our banking-grade DNA, we provide owners with clear, real-time visibility into their property's performance.
about_welcome_p1: "Hayyak" comes from the Arabic expression meaning "welcome." It reflects the warmth and generosity deeply rooted in Jordanian hospitality — a culture where guests are received with respect, care, and sincerity.
about_welcome_p2: We combine the spirit of Levantine welcome with institutional discipline and world-class service standards. Tenants feel valued and truly at home — owners feel confident their assets are managed with professionalism.
about_faq_owners_q1: How often do I receive reports?
about_faq_owners_a1: Monthly financial reports and quarterly performance reviews, with real-time access via our digital portal.
about_faq_owners_a2: Transparent and competitive, typically a percentage of collected rent. Contact us for a tailored proposal.
about_faq_owners_a3: Structured escalation process from reminders through legal channels when necessary.
about_faq_tenants_q1: How fast are maintenance requests handled?
about_faq_tenants_a1: Emergency within 2 hours. Standard maintenance within 24-48 hours.
about_faq_tenants_a2: Yes, 24/7 emergency hotline for all tenants.
about_faq_tenants_a3: Absolutely. Our platform supports seamless contract renewals.
about_coverage_body: Hayyak extends its services across Jordan, delivering comprehensive, end-to-end solutions nationwide. With strong local presence and in-depth market understanding, we support clients across various sectors.
about_careers_body: We're always looking for talented professionals passionate about real estate and technology to join our growing team.
services_hero_body: Comprehensive real estate services designed to navigate the complexities of the Levantine market, combining financial robustness with technical agility.
services_cta_body: Contact our team today to discuss how we can help optimize your property portfolio.
service_advisory_tag: End-to-end advisory across the asset lifecycle.
service_advisory_desc: End-to-end advisory for investors, developers, and institutional lenders — from development loan origination through to long-term asset performance and disposal.
service_advisory_bullet_1: Asset management strategy — positioning and optimisation
service_advisory_hero_sub: End-to-end advisory for investors, developers, and institutional lenders — from development loan origination through to long-term asset performance and disposal.
service_advisory_section_1_title: Four integrated practices covering the complete scope
service_advisory_section_1_item_1_body: Strategic advisory on asset positioning, performance optimisation, and investment return maximisation. Hold, reposition, or disposal decisions underpinned by rigorous financial modelling.
service_advisory_section_1_item_2_body: Structuring leasing strategies that maximise income, improve occupancy, and strengthen tenant covenant quality across commercial, retail, and mixed-use assets.
service_advisory_section_1_item_3_body: Day-to-day operational management covering rent collection, service charge administration, lease compliance, and vendor management with structured reporting.
service_advisory_section_1_item_4_body: Advisory support across the construction phase — monitoring contractor performance, programme adherence, and cost control to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery.
service_advisory_cta_title: Ready to engage a trusted adviser?
service_advisory_cta_body: Whether you are a lender, investor, or developer — speak with the Hayyak team about how our advisory capability can support your real estate objectives in Jordan.
service_valuation_desc: Formal, Red Book-compliant asset valuations through a network of locally qualified and RICS-registered firms — coordinated as part of a single, integrated service relationship.
service_valuation_bullet_1: Mortgage lending valuation — Red Book compliant
service_valuation_hero_sub: Formal, Red Book-compliant asset valuations through a network of locally qualified and RICS-registered firms — coordinated as part of a single, integrated service relationship.
service_valuation_section_1_title: Formal valuations at every trigger point
service_valuation_section_1_intro: Hayyak coordinates the full range of formal valuation types required across the real estate investment and lending lifecycle.
service_valuation_section_1_item_1_body: Red Book-compliant valuations for mortgage security purposes — an independent, defensible opinion of Market Value and Reinstatement Cost Assessment.
service_valuation_section_1_item_2_body: Residual valuation and development appraisal for proposed schemes — assessing viability, GDV assumptions, and development margin against cost plan.
service_valuation_section_1_item_3_body: Valuation of stabilised income-producing real estate on an investment basis — capitalisation of passing rent, ERV assessment, and reversionary potential.
service_valuation_section_1_item_4_body: Periodic desktop reviews and monitoring valuations for lender portfolio surveillance — updated value opinions between formal inspection cycles.
service_valuation_section_2_intro: All valuations coordinated by Hayyak are prepared in accordance with the RICS Valuation — Global Standards (Red Book).
service_valuation_section_2_item_1_body: Valuations prepared to RICS Valuation — Global Standards, ensuring compliance with the internationally recognised benchmark for professional property valuation.
service_valuation_section_2_item_2_body: All valuation firms in the Hayyak network are RICS-registered, with locally qualified valuers holding recognised professional designations.
service_valuation_section_2_item_3_body: Valuations instructed from independent, arms-length firms — providing the formal independence required for regulatory and credit purposes.
service_valuation_cta_body: Speak with Hayyak about coordinating a formal, RICS-compliant valuation for your real estate asset or portfolio in Jordan.
service_lender_desc: Independent Lender Technical Advisory for institutional lenders financing real estate development in Jordan — delivered in technical partnership with Rasekh Development Management LLC.
service_lender_hero_sub: Independent Lender Technical Advisory for institutional lenders financing real estate development in Jordan — delivered in technical partnership with Rasekh Development Management LLC.
service_lender_section_1_intro: The LTA service is structured across three integrated phases, each with defined deliverables and a formal reporting cycle aligned to the lender's drawdown schedule.
service_lender_section_1_item_1_body: Comprehensive review of all project documentation before the first drawdown — establishing the monitoring baseline and identifying material risks.
service_lender_section_1_item_2_body: Ongoing monthly site visits and formal reporting throughout the construction period — tracking progress, costs, and risks on behalf of the lender.
service_lender_section_1_item_3_body: Independent assessment and formal certification of each payment application — providing lenders with unambiguous disbursement recommendations.
service_lender_section_2_intro: Complete schedule of formal documents issued to the lender across all three service phases.
service_lender_section_2_row_1_desc: Pre-disbursement review establishing the monitoring baseline. Covers permits, contractor credentials, programme, cost plan, and drawdown schedule.
service_lender_section_2_row_2_desc: Documented identification and initial assessment of all material risks identified during the inception compliance review.
service_lender_section_2_row_3_desc: Structured report covering physical progress against programme, contractor performance, updated risk register, and financial status.
service_lender_section_2_row_4_desc: Formal certificate per payment application — confirms the certified sum and provides an unambiguous disbursement recommendation.
service_lender_section_2_row_5_desc: Final LTA report confirming practical completion status, outstanding defects, retention position, and residual risks.
service_lender_cta_title: Protect your loan from day one.
service_lender_cta_body: Speak with Hayyak about Lender Technical Advisory for your next real estate development facility in Jordan. Continuous monitoring providing the independent oversight needed to disburse with confidence.
service_property_desc: Tech-enabled property management transitioning your asset from a static expense to a dynamic investment — total transparency and operational excellence with institutional-grade reporting.
service_property_hero_sub: Full-service property management for income-producing real estate assets. Designed to protect collateral value and support loan serviceability throughout the life of an asset.
service_property_section_1_intro: Hayyak delivers full-service property management — from day-to-day operations and tenant relations through to planned maintenance and statutory compliance.
service_property_section_1_item_1_body: Systematic rent collection, service charge administration, arrears management, and financial reporting. Monthly owner statements and annual budgets prepared to institutional standards.
service_property_section_1_item_2_body: Active management of tenant relationships, lease covenant compliance monitoring, lease event management, and structured engagement throughout the lease term.
service_property_section_1_item_3_body: Structured planned and reactive maintenance — covering M&E systems, common areas, fabric maintenance, and service provider oversight.
service_property_section_1_item_4_body: Monitoring of statutory compliance — fire safety, statutory inspections, insurance maintenance, and regulatory reporting to local authorities.
service_property_section_1_item_5_body: Structured monthly reporting — covering occupancy, financial performance, maintenance status, and asset-level risk flags.
service_property_section_1_item_6_body: Strategic advice on capital expenditure, planned refurbishment, and asset enhancement programmes — designed to protect or improve market value.
service_property_section_2_title: Protecting lender interests throughout the asset lifecycle
service_property_section_2_intro: Designed with institutional lenders in mind — providing structured, transparent oversight needed to maintain collateral value and support loan serviceability.
service_property_section_2_item_1_body: Comprehensive asset inspection, documentation review, service provider assessment, and establishment of the management baseline — completed before active management commences.
service_property_section_2_item_2_body: Day-to-day operations, tenant management, financial reporting, and maintenance delivery — structured around a formal management plan and monthly reporting cycle.
service_property_section_2_item_3_body: Quarterly performance reviews against agreed KPIs, annual budget setting, and ongoing strategic advice on asset enhancement and income optimisation.
service_property_cta_body: Speak with Hayyak about full-service property management for your income-producing real estate assets in Jordan. Structured, transparent, and designed to protect both owner value and lender security.
service_leasing_tag: In-house leasing across all asset classes.
service_leasing_desc: Deep market intelligence to position your property effectively, attract and retain the right tenant mix, and structure leases that maximise income across commercial, residential, and mixed-use assets.
service_leasing_bullet_1: Strategic pricing and marketing to minimize vacancy
service_leasing_hero_sub: In-house leasing and brokerage across commercial, residential, and mixed-use assets — backed by Thabat PSC's network of institutional relationships throughout the Jordanian market.
service_leasing_section_1_intro: In-house leasing team operates across the full spectrum of income-producing real estate asset classes in Jordan — combining transactional expertise with deep occupier relationships.
service_leasing_section_1_item_1_body: Leasing of office, professional, and commercial premises — from single-floor suites to multi-storey office buildings. Focus on institutional-grade tenants and structured lease terms.
service_leasing_section_1_item_2_body: Leasing of residential units across Amman and wider Jordan. Structured letting programmes that maximise occupancy and minimise void periods.
service_leasing_section_1_item_3_body: Retail leasing and tenant mix optimisation for high street, neighbourhood, and mixed-use schemes — drawing on established occupier relationships.
service_leasing_section_2_intro: Every leasing instruction follows a structured four-stage process — minimising void periods and maximising the quality and security of income.
service_leasing_section_2_item_1_body: Rental market analysis, comparable evidence review, and competitive positioning — establishing the right asking rent and letting strategy before launch.
service_leasing_section_2_item_2_body: Targeted marketing across Hayyak's occupier network and referral channels — supplemented by digital and direct marketing where required.
service_leasing_section_2_item_3_body: Rigorous qualification of shortlisted tenants — financial standing, covenant quality, business profile, and fit with the asset's objectives.
service_leasing_section_2_item_4_body: Negotiation, heads of terms, legal instruction, lease execution, and structured handover to the management team.
service_leasing_cta_body: Speak with Hayyak's leasing team about bringing your commercial, residential, or mixed-use asset to market in Jordan. Structured, in-house execution backed by established occupier relationships.
